name: Teferi, Temporal Archmage
oracle_text:
+1: Look at the top two cards of your library. Put one of them into your hand and the other on the bottom of your library.
−1: Untap up to four target permanents.
−10: You get an emblem with "You may activate loyalty abilities of planeswalkers you control on any player's turn any time you could cast an instant."
Teferi, Temporal Archmage can be your commander.
blocked_sentences: Teferi, Temporal Archmage can be your commander.

needs.what: A card-level flag (e.g. `can_be_commander: true`) for the printed deck-building permission "<this card> can be your commander" (rule 903.3d), which the residual gate recognises as claiming that line, and which `registry.validate_deck` reads so that only legendary creatures and cards carrying the flag are legal commanders.
needs.why_existing_wont_do: No key in card_level_cost_keys, card_level_face_keys or card_level_rider_keys says anything about commander eligibility, and `verify._covered` has no claimant for the line, so it can only be claimed by an ability whose text is that sentence -- but it is neither an activated, triggered nor static ability and no static_effect means it. `registry.validate_deck` meanwhile accepts ANY legendary planeswalker as commander (`card.is_creature or "Planeswalker" in card.types`), which is broader than the printed rule, so the permission is not modelled per card. The other three lines are expressible: +1 is look_at_top amount 2 to hand with rest_to_bottom; -1 is untap over a permanent target with count 4 and up_to; -10 is the emblem op with an emblem static activate_loyalty_as_though_instant whose affects is {controller: you, types: [Planeswalker]} (command-zone statics are gathered by _command_zone_statics).
